name: XXL Pro
author: L'Cronx
summary: Fifteen process modules in the style of classic studio gear in one effect, joined on a touch patch bay: six compressors, five EQs with a preamp, two tape machines and two digital reverbs. Patch any module into any other, in series or parallel. 59 presets. By L'Cronx, GPL-3. Not endorsed by the makers of the originals.
